category_title: Young adults with profound intellectual disability who communicate through non-verbal vocalizations and physical approach or withdrawal
scenario_title: Motor movement exercise on a gym mat
minimal_context: John and a staff member are sitting on a gym mat to practice crawling through a plastic triangle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: John, crawl through the plastic triangle that is in front of you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (John is crouching on the mat and watches the tutor approach.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (John continues to sit cross-legged on the mat; he drops his head, puts his hands in his lap and looks blank.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: John, crawl through the plastic triangle that is in front of you.

STUDENT: (John is crouching on the mat and watches the tutor approach.)

TUTOR: (Crawls away) Come over here.

STUDENT: (John tries to grab her.)

TUTOR: Move that bum.

STUDENT: (John continues to sit cross-legged on the mat; he drops his head, puts his hands in his lap and looks blank.)

task.content: Crawl through the plastic triangle that is in front of him

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Al is trying to induce him to crawl... She says 'move that bum'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Continues to sit cross-legged on the mat; he drops his head, puts his hands in his lap and looks blank

behavior_patterns.condition: Al does not try to move him then she crawls away
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: John is crouching on the mat... John tries to grab her
